# WMO Present Weather symbols

Source: [OGC WorldWeatherSymbols, ww_PresentWeather](https://github.com/OGCMetOceanDWG/WorldWeatherSymbols/tree/1b907f04da74c6dfd89508bab119e330ffd2f7b0/symbols/ww_PresentWeather).

Symbol creator: WMO CBS IPET-DR&C. Copyright © 2013–2021 OGC Meteorology and Oceanography Domain Working Group. The [upstream repository](https://github.com/OGCMetOceanDWG/WorldWeatherSymbols/blob/1b907f04da74c6dfd89508bab119e330ffd2f7b0/LICENSE.md) and the symbols' machine-readable license metadata refer to [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). The original SVGs also retain a historical CC BY 3.0 Unported rights notice.

The local SVG combines the selected glyphs into a 55 px-per-code horizontal sprite in ascending code order. The original visible geometry and styles are preserved. Element IDs and internal references are prefixed per code. A reference in code 57 that already pointed to a missing element was omitted. Per-file metadata is replaced with shared attribution.
